observed: An exterior cutaway shows the lobby below three occupied trading floors and two empty upper levels in blue linework.
A visible elevator shaft joins the levels beside a stairwell.
The occupied floors read as dense bands of posts and people, with warm floors and paper scatter.
The building has street context while the cutaway makes its stacked interior the focus.
corrections: Keep parallel orthographic slabs and a cutaway that follows quarter turns; do not inherit the generated perspective fan.
Remove decorative brass from elevator cars, storefronts and revolving doors; a live reading is the only brass part.
Use varied jackets instead of letting every distant crowd collapse to navy and white.
Unbuilt levels use blueprint linework only, and actual floor counts follow occupancy; this image's count is composition evidence, not a product constant.
Do not infer building-rung geometry, density thresholds or impostor behaviour from this bitmap; those require renderer measurements.

Colour audit 13 October: replace tiled lobby floor with timber, remove opaque fills from blueprint stories, and correct decorative gold on doors/elevator parts. The narrow image supplies no measurable proof for every material ramp or engraved scale.
